hook.en: Every derivative rule you will ever use comes from one limit. Today we build derivatives from scratch.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಬಳಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅವಕಲಜ ನಿಯಮವೂ ಒಂದೇ ಮಿತಿಯಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂದು ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟೋಣ.

objectives.en: Define the derivative at a point and as a function
Differentiate simple functions from first principles

narration.en: Every derivative rule you will ever use comes from one limit. Today we build derivatives from scratch.
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಬಳಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅವಕಲಜ ನಿಯಮವೂ ಒಂದೇ ಮಿತಿಯಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂದು ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟೋಣ.

body.en: The derivative of $f$ at $a$ is $f'(a) = \lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(a+h)-f(a)}{h}$, if this limit exists. Doing the same at a general $x$ gives the derivative function $f'(x)$, also written $\frac{dy}{dx}$ or $\frac{d}{dx}f(x)$. Finding it straight from this limit is called differentiating from first principles.
body.kn: f(x + h) − f(x) ಅನ್ನು h ಇಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ h → 0 ಮಿತಿ ತೆಗೆದರೆ ಅವಕಲಜ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವುದೇ ಮೊದಲ ತತ್ವ.

narration.en: The derivative is the limit of f of x plus h minus f of x, over h, as h tends to zero. Working it out directly is called the first principle.
narration.kn: f(x + h) − f(x) ಅನ್ನು h ಇಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ h → 0 ಮಿತಿ ತೆಗೆದರೆ ಅವಕಲಜ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುವುದೇ ಮೊದಲ ತತ್ವ.

body.en: $\frac{d}{dx}(c) = 0$, $\frac{d}{dx}(x) = 1$, $\frac{d}{dx}(x^2) = 2x$, $\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac1x\right) = -\frac1{x^2}$, $\frac{d}{dx}(\sin x) = \cos x$ and $\frac{d}{dx}(\cos x) = -\sin x$. The trigonometric results use the limits $\frac{\sin h}{h} \to 1$ and $\frac{1 - \cos h}{h} \to 0$.
body.kn: ಮೊದಲ ತತ್ವದಿಂದ: ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕದ ಅವಕಲಜ 0, x² ನದು 2x, sin x ನದು cos x, cos x ನದು −sin x.

narration.en: From first principles: the derivative of a constant is zero, of x squared is two x, of sine is cosine and of cosine is minus sine.
narration.kn: ಮೊದಲ ತತ್ವದಿಂದ: ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕದ ಅವಕಲಜ 0, x² ನದು 2x, sin x ನದು cos x, cos x ನದು −sin x.

problem.en: Find the derivative of f(x) = x² from first principles.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the derivative of f(x) = x² from first principles.

problem.en: Find the derivative of f(x) = 1/x from first principles.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the derivative of f(x) = 1/x from first principles.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two exam-pattern questions of the kind asked in KCET, COMEDK and JEE. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: f′(x) = lim [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h as h → 0.
d/dx(sin x) = cos x; d/dx(cos x) = −sin x.
points.kn: d/dx(sin x) = cos x; d/dx(cos x) = −sin x.

homework.en: Find the derivative of x² − 2 at x = 10 from first principles.

narration.en: Recap. f′(x) = lim [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h as h → 0. d/dx(x²) = 2x; d/dx(1/x) = −1/x². d/dx(sin x) = cos x; d/dx(cos x) = −sin x.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. f′(x) = lim [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h, h → 0. d/dx(x²) = 2x; d/dx(1/x) = −1/x². d/dx(sin x) = cos x; d/dx(cos x) = −sin x.
